question: Name the scheme launched by the Prime Minister on 17 September 2023 that aims to improve the lives of artisans.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Vishwakarma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Vishwakarma** is the scheme launched by the Prime Minister on 17 September 2023.
 
• The scheme aims to **improve the lives of artisans** by providing them with various forms of support.
 
• It focuses on enhancing the skills, tools, and market access for artisans, thereby enabling them to earn a better livelihood.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's broader efforts to promote traditional crafts and workmanship across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme is expected to benefit a large number of artisans by **providing financial assistance, skill training, and market linkages**.
 
• It aims to preserve and promote **India's rich cultural heritage** by supporting traditional crafts and workmanship.
 
• Artisans under this scheme will have access to modern tools and technology to enhance their productivity and quality of work.
 
• The scheme also includes provisions for the **promotion and marketing** of products made by artisans, both domestically and internationally.
